events.label: Наука
entries: 1944 – The experimental MW 18014 V-2 rocket reaches an altitude of 176 km, becoming the first man-made object to reach outer space.
1990 – Asteroid Eureka is discovered.
1996 – Space Shuttle Columbia launches on STS-78 to conduct life science and microgravity research aboard the Spacelab module.

events.label: Искусство
entries: 1975 – The film Jaws is released in the United States, becoming the highest-grossing film of that time and starting the trend of films known as "summer blockbusters".

events.label: Образование
entries: 2003 – The Wikimedia Foundation is founded in St. Petersburg, Florida.
